description: GUI dataset explorer — a read-only local web app for navigating and viewing the corpus across all three representations (canonical TSV, Neo4j property graph, and Prolog/Datalog), and for surfacing scraping completeness (which categories are complete, incomplete, failed, or never run). Reads the pipeline's existing outputs; never writes them. Depends on tasklists 1-6 (it visualizes their outputs).

tasks.title: T7-US-001: Scaffold the read-only explorer web app and `serve` command
tasks.description:
As a developer, I want a read-only web-app skeleton behind an optional extra so the GUI is isolated from the core pipeline.

Acceptance criteria (all must be met before marking complete):
- Add an optional 'gui' extra in pyproject.toml (fastapi, uvicorn, jinja2)
- Create src/pinakes_engine/explorer/ with an app factory and a `pinakes_engine serve <job-output-root>` CLI subcommand that launches the server on a configurable --host/--port
- The app is read-only and serves an index page listing the loaded corpus and the available views; a missing 'gui' extra fails with a clear install hint, mirroring the optional neo4j extra
- TestClient hits the index route and gets 200 with the corpus name
- Tests pass (pytest) — drive HTTP routes with FastAPI's TestClient (no live server)
- Lint passes (ruff)
- Type checks pass (mypy)

Project context: pinakes-engine — see PLAN.md, docs/quickstart.md, and docs/data-model.md. The explorer is strictly read-only and reads the pipeline's existing outputs: the canonical node/edge TSV plus catalog.json, metrics.json, qa.json and per-category reports (docs/storage.md), the Neo4j export (docs/neo4j.md), and the Datalog programs and example queries (docs/datalog.md). Build a local web app (FastAPI + Uvicorn + Jinja2 behind an optional 'gui' extra; Cytoscape.js via CDN for graph views, no JS build step). Everything must be exercisable offline against the fixture corpus under tests/fixtures/. Work in src/pinakes_engine/explorer/. This story belongs to tasklist 'ralph/gui-explorer'.

tasks.title: T7-US-002: Build the corpus data-access layer the views share
tasks.description:
As a developer, I want one typed, read-only loader for a job output root so every view reads from a single source of truth.

Acceptance criteria (all must be met before marking complete):
- Load the canonical nodes/edges TSV plus catalog.json, metrics.json, qa.json and per-category reports into typed view models
- Accept either a full job output root (out/<job>/) or a bare corpus directory (one holding nodes/ and edges/); a clear error when neither is found
- Parse once and cache; expose lookups by csid and by :LABEL/:TYPE
- Tested against the fixture corpus under tests/fixtures/
- Tests pass (pytest) — drive HTTP routes with FastAPI's TestClient (no live server)
- Lint passes (ruff)
- Type checks pass (mypy)

tasks.title: T7-US-003: Browse and search the node/edge tables with a detail view
tasks.description:
As a data curator, I want to browse and search the canonical TSV and inspect any entity so I can see exactly what was scraped.

Acceptance criteria (all must be met before marking complete):
- Paginated node and edge tables, filterable by :LABEL / :TYPE and by free-text on name / csid
- A node detail view shows every canonical column, the provenance columns, and the node's incident edges (in and out)
- All data comes from the T7-US-002 data-access layer; no re-parsing
- TestClient covers the table, filter, and detail routes on the fixture
- Tests pass (pytest) — drive HTTP routes with FastAPI's TestClient (no live server)

tasks.title: T7-US-004: Scraping completeness dashboard
tasks.description:
As an operator, I want to see at a glance which categories are complete, incomplete, failed, or never run so I know what still needs scraping.

Acceptance criteria (all must be met before marking complete):
- Read catalog.json, qa.json and the per-category reports; render one row per category with status, node/edge counts, QA violations, last_run, and provenance completeness
- Explicitly flag incomplete categories (zero or low row counts, gate violations, fetch errors) and categories absent from the catalog (never run)
- The table is sortable and filterable by status
- TestClient asserts a known-incomplete fixture category is flagged
- Tests pass (pytest) — drive HTTP routes with FastAPI's TestClient (no live server)
- Lint passes (ruff)
- Type checks pass (mypy)

tasks.title: T7-US-009: Cross-representation entity linking via the csid
tasks.description:
As an explorer, I want to view the same entity across the TSV, Neo4j, and Datalog representations so the three stores feel like one dataset.

Acceptance criteria (all must be met before marking complete):
- From a node detail, deep-link to that entity's Neo4j node (by csid) and its Datalog atom (node('<csid>')), using the csid as the shared join key across all three views
- Round-trip navigation works: TSV detail -> graph -> back, and TSV -> Datalog console pre-filled with a goal for that csid
- A link-resolution layer maps a csid to each representation's locator
- TestClient covers link resolution for a fixture csid
- Tests pass (pytest) — drive HTTP routes with FastAPI's TestClient (no live server)
- Lint passes (ruff)
- Type checks pass (mypy)
